tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: rdzogs chen lta ba klong yangs las: rdo rje sems dpa' 'bru gsum rgyal ba'i spyi sgrub bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈ sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: na mo: dag pa dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du: thig le rang gsal tshom bu rgyas: ye shes rig pa zang thal le: bdag 'dzin bral bar skyabs su mchi: rang rig gsal ba'i snying po can: sgrib g.yogs med par zang thal le: phyogs mtshams med par khyab gdal le: gsal 'grib med par dwangs sing nge: ngos lkog med par rjen ce re: rgya mtshor gza' skar shar ba 'dra: 'du 'bral med par bum pa'i sku: rang grol chen por skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed pa ni: ci ltar thog ma'i mgon po nyid: ma bskyed gzhi la rdzogs pa'i sku: gnas lnga 'od kyi mu khyud mdzes: rig stong gsal bar chos longs sprul: 'pho 'gyur med par lhang nge shar: 'od phung nam mkha'i mtha' dang mtshungs: sgo dang yul dang rig pa gsum: 'du 'bral med par sems bskyed do: dngos gzhi bskyed bzlas rim pa ni: ho: snod ldan byang chub sems 'dod na: bla med lam du 'jug pa ni: rang rig gsal stong hur po 'di: ma bris gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog: mi g.yo lhang nge rgya chad bral: kun bzang yum chen ngang du bsgom: de ltar ma rtogs sems can rnams: yid gsum rkyen bzhis rang bcings pas: sdug bsngal chen po snying re rje: bzod blag med pa'i thugs rje yis: rnam byang gzhi la rdzogs par bya: 'khor dang 'das pa'i chos rnams kun: ngo bo stong la rang bzhin gsal: rtsal shugs 'gag pa med pa la: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: 'od khyim dbyings kyi pho brang du: hūm̐ las bla ma rdo rje sems: dri med dkar mdangs rig pa'i sku: gzhon tshul phyed skyil rdor dril bsnams: yum mchog rdo rje snyems ma yang: dkar mo gri thod yab la 'khyud: rin chen rgyan spras mtshan dper ldan: blta bas mi ngom tshul dgus mdzes: ye nas rang yin gsal yang gdab: bdag gi snying nang zhi ba'i lha: sum cu rtsa drug gsal bar bskyed:

klad pa dung khang gzhal yas khang: khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad gsal: rtsa mdud drug la thub pa drug: 'khor lo lnga la dhā ki lnga: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dri med gsal: kun kyang sku chung yungs 'bru tsam: gsal 'tsher nyi zla'i snying po 'dra: phyag mtshan rang rtags yum dang 'khril: thugs rje'i spyan ni phul thag tsam: 'khor 'das chos kun gsal bar gzigs: sna tshogs cer grol nyid du gsal: bdag nyid de ltar gsal ba yi: mdzod spu mgrin pa snying kha ru: ye shes mu khyud lnga ldan zhing: dkar dmar mthing kha'i thig le'i nang: oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing gsum: lhang lhang tser tser mer mer rnams: thig le oṃ dkar 'od 'phros pas: snang srid thams cad oṃ du gyur: 'od zhu ngag tu oṃ bzlas pas: lus sgrib dag nas snang stong rtogs: ma hā sku yi dbang thob bsam: thig le āḥdamar 'od 'phros pas: snang srid thams cad āḥru gyur: 'od zhu ngag tu āḥbazlas pas: ngag sgrib dag nas bde stong rtogs: a nu gsung gi dbang thob bsam: thig le hūm̐ mthing 'od 'phros pas: snang srid thams cad hūm̐ du gyur: 'od zhu ngag tu hūm̐ bzlas pas: yid sgrib dag nas gsal stong rtogs: a ti thugs kyi dbang thob bsam: oṃ dang āḥdang hūm̐ gsum rtogs: rnam rtog phra rags sbom gsum dag: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug grol: gzugs khams 'dod khams stong khams sbyangs: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rjer ldan: chos sku longs sku sprul sku thob: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi snying po 'di: sgra dbyangs dang bcas bye ba bzlas: 'di ni bsnyen pa'i rim pa 'o: bzlas bsgom ma yengs de nyid las: spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: bla ma kun bzang brgyud par bcas: tho brtsegs tshul du bzhugs pa yi: g.yas g.yon chos skyong dam can bskor: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnams: dgyes tshul dngos grub bdag nyid can: spung nge thibs se bzhugs par bsgom: rang nyid 'bru gsum srog yig las:

'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa yis: ye shes gsum ldan bla ma brgyud: dbyings rig dbyer med zhi khro'i lha: sgron ma bzhi ldan mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: gsal stong lhang nge 'jam dpal sku: grags stong seng nge pad+ma'i gsung: rig stong 'dzin med yang dag thugs: bde stong lhan skyes bdud rtsi'i lha: snang stong hrig ge phur phrin las: mi rtog so ma ma mo'i tshogs: snang bzhi blo zad mchod bstod lha: ma 'gags shar grol drag po'i tshogs: snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku: rkyen gsum bral ba'i dbyings kyi nang: 'ja' 'od thig le'i pho brang du: sprin phung ltar gtibs gdan bzhugs bsam: de ltar don dam kun rdzob tshul: ma 'gags rol pas spyan yang drang: hūm̐: kun bzang ye shes snying po lhun grub mchog: ma nor ma bcos sku yi lha tshogs gshegs: snang stong dran stong rig stong so ma'i klong: gsung gi lha tshogs thig le'i klong du gshegs: ma 'gags rang byung ma yengs rang bzhin grol: thugs kyi lha tshogs dbyings chen ngang du gshegs: bar der brgyud pa'i bla ma la: gdangs snyan tshig gis gsol ba gdab: cir mi dgongs de'i ngang nyid las: gzugs snang thams cad lha yi sku: sgra grags thams cad 'bru gsum sgra: dran rtog thams cad mi rtog pa: ci mdzad rol pa'i phyag rgya bsgyur: de ltar gsal ba'i ngang nyid la: spyi gtsug rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams: 'bru gsum kha dog thig ler zhu: bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi: dung khang nang du khra mer bzhugs: sgrib pa bag chags thams cad kun: sol khu bdas ltar 'og sgor thon: rgyu ma chus bkrus ci lta bar: phyi nang med par zang thal dag: shel sgong mchod rten lta bur gyur: rkang mthil spyi gtsug phyi nang rnams: bdud rtsis zho rkyal khengs ltar bsam: oṃ las sku yi bdud rtsi dkar: āḥlas gsung gi bdud rtsi dmar: hūm̐ las thugs kyi bdud rtsi mthing: bdud rtsi gsum gyi byin rlabs kyis:

dug gsum dag nas sku gsum thob: dbang bzhi thob nas rgyud bzhi grol: sku bzhi mthar phyin zhing bzhi bgrod: dga' bzhi myangs nas snang bzhi phyin: gding bzhi thob nas gnyis chos zad: ka dag zang thal chen por bsgom: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum bye bas 'grub: rjes ni rdzogs rim ngo yang sprad: dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi: yab kyi snying po oṃ yin te: yum gy-i snying po yi ge ā: yab yum gnyis med hūm̐ yin no: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku sgrub oṃ la gsung sgrub ā: thugs kyi sgrub pa hūm̐ yin no: bskyed pa oṃ la rdzogs pa ā: gnyis med zung 'jug hūm̐ yin no: bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi: lus la oṃ gyis rgyas gdab pas: mi 'gyur bde gshegs sku yi rigs: ye shes lnga ldan dbang thob shog: ngag la gsung gis rgyas gdab pas: smra brjod yul 'das chos sgra dbang: āḥgrags stong chos sgra'i dbang thob shog: sems la hūm̐ gis rgyas gdab pas: spros bral blo 'das zhig pa'i ngang: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: oṃ ni bde la āḥni gsal: hūm̐ ni mi rtog gnyis mtha' zad: 'khor 'das srog snying 'bru gsum 'di: bla med sngags kyi rgyal po yin: sangs rgyas kun gyis bstan pa yin: 'di las zab pa'i sgrub pa ni: ma byung mi 'byung phyis mi 'byung: oṃ gyis snang srid g.yo zhing 'gul: āḥyis khams gsum dbang du bsgyur: hūm̐ gis skye med don bya 'o: oṃ gyis snang nyams gsal bar byed: āḥyis rig pa tshad la phebs: hūm̐ gis mi zad mya ngan 'das: oṃ gyis 'dod khams sprul skur sbyor: āḥyis gzugs khams longs skur sbyor: hūm̐ gis stong khams chos skur sbyor: oṃ gyis mngon par sangs rgyas sbyor: āḥyis yang dag sangs rgyas sbyor: hūm̐ gis 'khor ba dong sprugs pas: 'bad med 'dod zhig ngang la zhog: ces gsungs pa'i don gyis rgyas gdab bo:
